The lead directed on 2026-10-06 that the picker (Jev) should make more routing decisions, while an explicit --local stays authoritative. The user-global routing rule now says: dispatch crew nodes without --local or --backend by default, and name a lane only when the run must go there, giving the reason in --comment. That is dotfiles agents/AGENTS.md, Runtime Model Routing, committed at 063d530.

Measured: 1,102 of 1,104 promoted dispatches since 2026-10-04 named their lane, so Jev only shadowed. reckon's own surfaces still teach and compose --local by default, and this node aligns them.

1. Skills and references stop prescribing --local as the default for a new dispatch. Keep it as the documented answer to "use local workers". Change it where it is presented as what a coordinator adds to every dispatch:
   - skills/reckon-build/SKILL.md (the locally-served routing paragraph, and the review-plan examples);
   - skills/reckon-build/references/coordinator-reference.md;
   - skills/reckon-build/references/effort-routing.md where it applies;
   - skills/reckon-create/SKILL.md and skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md examples.
   State the new default in mechanism terms: the picker chooses the lane or holds; a named lane is never overridden; reviews stay off metered lanes through review_excluded_backends, so an unnamed review runs locally or holds.
2. reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py rewrites a composed remedy's --backend into --local. A remedy that dispatches new work (a missing review, a new node) should name no lane. A remedy that continues an existing run (resume, redispatch, repair of that run) keeps the run's own lane. Change the rewrite accordingly and keep its local-lane guard for continuations.
3. Do not change reckon/crew/recovery.py. The review reflex's lane-follows-its-run rule is out of scope: reviews can only run locally or hold anyway.
4. Update the tests that assert the old default:
   - tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py
   - tests/test_skill_contracts.py
   - tests/test_an_edit_tells_its_author_a_review_is_owed.py
   - tests/test_crew.py, only where it asserts this rewrite or skill text.
   Add one test in tests/test_new_work_names_no_lane.py: a missing-review remedy composes no lane, while a resume remedy keeps the run's lane.

Gate: those four test files, the new one. Run them with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 in the FOREGROUND, with one log for base and one for head under the run directory, each ending in an EXIT line, judged by delta.
